title: Ironhollow Rising Revisited
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Ines Iversen, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
